text: Then look at the room. If the big light is on and five concerned people are talking at once, no wonder they're scared, because a huge amount of what looks like profound psychedelic crisis is a frightened nervous system stuck in an annoying room. Put a lamp on instead, keep one or two people with them and send the rest out. Don't let anyone touch them unless they want it, and that goes for you too. If they're trapped beside somebody they don't trust, move them. After that it's the dull stuff, whether they're too hot or too cold, or desperate for the bathroom.
section: Psychological First Aid: The First Five Minutes
reader: someone looking after a person in a frightening psychedelic or MDMA state, in the first few minutes, once the immediate dangers (keys, stove, roads, more of the substance) are dealt with

sentences.s: If the big light is on and five concerned people are talking at once, no wonder they're scared, because a huge amount of what looks like profound psychedelic crisis is a frightened nervous system stuck in an annoying room.
sentences.payoff: the helper sees the room as the person does, a big light and five worried people talking at once, and learns his reason why that keeps them scared
sentences.follows: it answers "Then look at the room" with the two things a helper would notice first, and his reason for why they matter

sentences.s: Put a lamp on instead, keep one or two people with them and send the rest out.
sentences.payoff: the helper learns the fixes for those two things: a lamp for the big light, and one or two people kept with them, the rest sent out
sentences.follows: the fixes for the two things the sentence before named

sentences.s: Don't let anyone touch them unless they want it, and that goes for you too.
sentences.payoff: the helper learns that nobody touches the person unless the person wants it, the helper included
sentences.follows: after the people in the room, what they do: touching

sentences.s: If they're trapped beside somebody they don't trust, move them.
sentences.payoff: the helper learns to move the person away from someone they don't trust
sentences.follows: the last of the people in the room

sentences.s: After that it's the dull stuff, whether they're too hot or too cold, or desperate for the bathroom.
sentences.payoff: the helper learns the plain body checks to make, in his words: too hot, too cold, desperate for the bathroom
sentences.follows: after the room and the people, the person's own body; "After that" puts it in order

placement: where his room paragraph was, right after the first-five-minutes dangers paragraph; his reason paragraph and his fixes paragraph's lights, people and touch go into it, so each check sits beside its fix

question_text.Q3: Which thing exactly? (pools of water, not water; any substance, not anything)
question_text.Q4: What does each word act on, or mean here? (adjunct remedy; known-genuine)

question_text.Q6: Is this the order the reader is thinking in, and does each idea sit next to what it continues?
